The '''T-Series Imperial Protocol Droid''' was a type of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]. Four of these [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were part of the [[Void Droid]]s patrolling the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]], where they were armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]].
